verdict.rationale: Canny is a feedback and roadmap tool, so rescheduling initiatives across releases is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows updating idea statuses, querying the roadmap, and publishing changelogs. Nothing documents rescheduling initiatives, setting target dates, or moving items between releases; workflow status changes are an adjacent feature, not release rescheduling.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can reschedule initiatives and move them between releases as priorities change
